route_source: active path points from authoritative stage timeline, coordinates rounded to 4 decimal places; tangent yaw reconstructed; far final yaw unused in cropped local horizon; tail length restored from recorded controller_diagnostics.original_pose_count
costmap_source: captured OccupancyGrid, fed via StaticLayer; preserves lethal100/unknown-1 exactly; intermediate soft costs re-quantized by StaticLayer, not exact byte replay
tf_source: latest captured map->odom and odom->base before freeze; same TF source frame as captured costmap
history_limit: fresh controller initializes oscillation critic anew; past critic state is not captured
